summary.en: Cristiano Ronaldo made his injury comeback for Al Nassr and struck his 980th career goal in the 23rd minute, turning home a rebound from a Kingsley Coman effort as the club cruised to a 3-0 win. Home fans unfurled a giant banner in support of the Portuguese star as he edged ever closer to the 1,000-goal landmark.

summary.zh_hant: C朗拿度傷癒復出重返艾納斯，在第23分鐘接應高文射門補射破網，攻入職業生涯第980球，助球隊3:0大勝。主場球迷展示巨型橫額力撐這位葡萄牙巨星，距離千球里程碑又近一步。

title.en: Ronaldo returns from injury to fire 980th career goal as Al Nassr win 3-0 amid giant fan banner

summary.en: China held the founding ceremony for its 5th Asian Para Games delegation in Beijing, naming a 500-member squad including 312 athletes from 25 provinces and 13 ethnic groups. Competing in 17 sports and 335 events at the Nagoya Games from October 18 to 24, it is China's largest-ever delegation to an overseas Asian Para Games.

summary.zh_hant: 第五屆亞洲殘疾人運動會中國體育代表團成立大會10月10日上午在北京舉行，代表團共500人，其中運動員312人，來自25個省區市、涵蓋13個民族。代表團將參加10月18至24日在日本名古屋舉行的亞殘運會17個大項335個小項，是我國參加境外亞殘運會規模最大的一屆。

title.en: China names 500-strong delegation for 5th Asian Para Games in Nagoya, its largest ever overseas squad

summary.en: Beijing's Shijingshan police announced that 20 people gathered in an arena passageway during the WTT China Smash on October 6 and hurled abuse at China national team coach Wang Hao as he passed by, also spreading insults and footage online. Three ringleaders aged 16 to 19 have been placed under administrative detention, while the other 17 received warnings and education.

summary.zh_hant: 北京石景山警方通報，10月6日WTT中國大滿貫賽事期間，楊某某等20人在賽場通道聚集，對途經的國乒教練員（王皓）進行辱罵，還在網上散布侮辱言論及現場視頻。其中楊某某等3名情節較重者被處以行政拘留，其餘17人被批評教育。

title.en: Beijing police detain 3 over verbal abuse of China coach Wang Hao at WTT China Smash

summary.en: The 2026 China Women's Golf Open teed off at PGA An Ying Golf Club on Chongming Island in Shanghai, its first-ever staging there. Last season's CLPGA money-list winner Shi Yuli carded a 4-under 68 to take the solo first-round lead, one shot ahead of Sui Xiang and Cai Danlin on 69.

summary.zh_hant: 首次登陸上海崇明島的2026中國女子高爾夫球公開賽9日在PGA安瀛高爾夫俱樂部展開首輪爭奪。2025賽季女子中巡積分王石昱莉打出68桿、低於標準桿4桿單獨領跑，隋響與蔡丹琳同以69桿並列第二。

summary.en: Michael Carrick called for a swift resolution to the Manchester City financial case after an independent commission ruled the club seriously breached rules across the 2009/10 to 2017/18 seasons, with fines, points deductions and even title stripping on the table. The former Manchester United midfielder revealed his old club finished runners-up to City twice during that nine-season stretch, admitting the saga has affected him personally.

Both Chinese stars advanced in style and keep national hopes alive in the singles draw.

summary.en: Everton issued an official statement confirming that owner The Friedkin Group is exploring new investment options, including a sale of its controlling stake. The American consortium, which bought a 99.5% shareholding for £400 million in December 2024, promised to find a suitable buyer for the Premier League club.
summary.zh_hans: 英超爱华顿发布官方声明，确认班主美国财团 The Friedkin Group 正探索包括出售球会控股權在内的新投资方案，并承诺为球会寻找合适买家。TFG 于 2024 年 12 月以 4 亿英镑收购爱华顿 99.5% 股权，不足两年便寻求卖盘，震撼英超。
summary.zh_hant: 英超愛華頓發布官方聲明，確認班主美國財團 The Friedkin Group 正探索包括出售球會控股權在內的新投資方案，並承諾為球會尋找合適買家。TFG 於 2024 年 12 月以 4 億鎊收購愛華頓 99.5% 股權，不足兩年便尋求賣盤，震撼英超。

title.en: Everton for sale: Friedkin Group seeks buyer less than two years after £400m takeover

summary.en: The Houston Rockets beat the Dallas Mavericks 135-117 in the opening game of the 2026 NBA China Games in Macau. Kevin Durant scored 15 points and asked to stay in for the second half; coach Ime Udoka said Durant will sit out the next game. Yao Ming, Jackie Chan, David Beckham, Jeremy Lin and Keung To were among the star-studded crowd.
